decision.observation: At 11:00 p.m., the farmer is still on the east–west dirt road, far from the beach; Willy's shop has been closed for hours.
decision.hypothesis: Returning west now should reach the farmhouse before 2:00 a.m. and avoid another overnight money loss, allowing an earlier beach trip tomorrow.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach; the Fish Shop is open 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Passing out has twice reduced money. From the farm, use the mailbox-level path east through this road into Pelican Town, then find the southern route instead of continuing to the eastern riverbank.
